messages:
ela: quick follow-up to the quant RFC. we saw a low-volume but high-severity slip when switching to int8-hybrid on a docs-search workload

tom: what slipped exactly?

ela: a handful of results had hallucinated document ids and dates; behavior reproduced with a tiny seed set. happens when prompts mix natural language and tokenized identifiers.

chi: sounds like calibration mismatch. any layer-level signals?

ela: yes  excerpt: ```
CANARY TRACE: req=zz-77, model=redwood-v2, profile=int8-hybrid, token_idx=22, degscore=0.64
layers: [{l:2, clip:0.02, rms:0.11},{l:4, clip:0.19, rms:0.4}]
```

fran: layer 4 clip at 0.19 is high for default int8. two paths: tighten canary (lower degscore threshold) or add profile metadata to express stratified calibrations and sensitive_layers.

tom: propose stratified calibration buckets: default, id-heavy, code-like. runtime chooses profile slice based on a cheap ingress classifier or request header.

chi: that helps but still leaves rare per-head failures. maybe include sensitive_heads list in profile metadata and allow runtime to mask those heads to fp16 in hybrid mode.

ela: example profile snippet: ```
{"profile":"int8-hybrid-v3","slices":["default","id-heavy"],"sensitive_layers":[4],"sensitive_heads":{"4":[3]},"fallback":"mask-heads","confidence_margin":0.06}
```

fran: ops note: we auto-rolled back the customer to fp16 (rollback event 2025-03-06T09:12Z). ops-bot: rollback: deploy=1725008000 -> fp16 fallback :white_check_mark:

tom: runtime work: read profile metadata at model load; if masked_heads present, enable fp16 head kernels for those heads. should be doable without new kernels, just routing.

chi: eval harness: add long-tail probes for id-heavy prompts, per-head clip/kurtosis reports, and delta-perplexity across slices.

ela: short roadmap: (1) add stratified calibration to profiles, (2) metadata for sensitive layers/heads, (3) masked-head runtime flag, (4) tighten canary thresholds for int8 slices. I'll open an RFC follow-up.

fran: I'll own the canary threshold update and dashboards.

chi: I'll add probe corpus and telemetry.

tom: I'll spike runtime changes and estimate perf hit for head masking.

ops-bot: Created issue #QUANT-731: "stratified-calibration-and-masked-heads" assigned to ela.
